messages.content:
To address the issue, we should either modify an existing method or introduce a new method to handle `Boolean` values properly, including `null`.

### Diagnosis

The test `com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriterTest.testBoxedBooleans()` fails due to a `java.lang.NullPointerException` when attempting to handle `null` as a `Boolean`. The failure occurs because there isn't a dedicated method in `JsonWriter` to handle `Boolean` values, including `null`. The code currently has:

- `value(boolean)` — handles primitive `boolean`.
- `nullValue()` — handles `null` values in general.

However, there is no direct way to handle `Boolean` objects, which would need to check for `null` and delegate to `nullValue()`, similar to how `value(Number)` works.

### Suggested Fix Locations

```plaintext
com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter.value(Boolean): add this method to handle Boolean objects correctly.
com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriterTest.testBoxedBooleans:292 ensure new method use in the test case.
```

Based on the available information, provide the specific lines of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate line numbers of all likely culprits (in `FullClassName.MethodName(ParameterType1, ParameterType2, ...):Linenumber` format), without commentary (one per line).
